scope: First coherent repair batch: Conditioning Field, Shared Surface Priority Map, and legacy investment comparison tables, with reusable source-label and all-column observation contracts.

comparisonPolicy.name: same-family-check-after-each-source-or-harness-repair-opportunity
comparisonPolicy.rule: Count a potential focused campaign after each distinct repair opportunity. Record bundled opportunities and actual campaigns separately. The counterfactual is a policy comparison, not observed human behavior or causal proof.
comparisonPolicy.fullSweepRule: A changed shared owner, omitted current family, or unexplained cross-family regression can reopen discovery. A local application or harness defect reopens its dependent cases.
comparisonPolicy.checkpoint: First family handoff or three coherent repair batches, whichever occurs first

estimation.model: Beta-Bernoulli late-defect indicator per completed handoff opportunity
estimation.exposureDefinition: A completed family handoff followed by an independently observed review window
estimation.reason: Prospective application exposure begins with this epoch. Previous setup repairs are not family handoff failures. Exact finite-state research remains a sensitivity aid; measured transitions are required for empirical rate or diffusion claims.

nextDecision: Run the fixture-gated affected-family campaign once; retain completed cases and classify each remaining condition before choosing the next focused observation.
